antiphona-i: The Lord said * unto my Lord: sit Thou at my right hand.
antiphona-ii: All his commandments * are sure; they stand fast for ever and ever.
antiphona-iii: In His Commandments * he delighteth greatly.
antiphona-iv: Blessed be the Name * of the Lord for evermore.
antiphona-v: We that live, * bless the Lord.

datum: Blessed be God, even the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, + the Father of mercies, and the God of all comfort, * Who comforteth us in all our tribulation.
V. Let my prayer, O Lord, be set forth.
R. As incense before Thee.
V. Drop down, ye heavens, from above, and let the skies pour down the Righteous One.
R. Let the earth open, and let her bring forth the Saviour.
V. God hath given His Angels charge over thee.
R. To keep thee in all thy ways.
V. Deliver me, O Lord, from the evil man.
R. Preserve me from the wicked man.
V. Lord, abide with us, Alleluia.
R. For it is toward evening, Alleluia.

antiphona-i: The Lord hath inclined * His ear unto me.
antiphona-ii: I believed, * therefore have I spoken.
antiphona-iii: O praise * the Lord, all ye nations.
antiphona-iv: I cried * and He heard me.

datum: The sceptre shall not depart from Judah, nor the law-giver from his loins, + until he that shall be sent cometh; * and unto him shall the desire of the Gentiles be.

The Priests, the ministers of the Lord, shall weep between the porch and the altar, and shall say: + Spare, O Lord, spare Thy people, * and give not thine heritage to reproach, that the heathen should rule over them.
But: O Lord of Sabaoth, That judgest righteously, and triest the reins and the heart, + let me see Thy vengeance on them: * for unto Thee, have I revealed my cause, O Lord my God.
Christ, being raised from the dead, dieth no more, death hath no more dominion over Him. + For in that He died, He died unto sin once: * but in that He liveth, He liveth unto God.
My soul doth magnify the Lord, * for God hath regarded my lowliness.
Kyrie eleison. Christe eleison. Kyrie eleison.
V. I said: Lord, be merciful unto me.
R. Heal my sou, for I have sinned against Thee.
V. Return, O Lord, how long?
R. And let it repent Thee concerning Thy servants.
V. Let Thy mercy, O Lord, be upon us.
R. According as we hope in Thee.
V. Let Thy priests be clothed with righteousness.
R. And let Thy Saints shout for joy.
V. O Lord, save the King.
R. And hear us in the day when we call upon Thee.
V. O Lord, save Thy people, and bless Thine inheritance.
R. And govern them, and lift them up for ever.
V. Remember Thy congregation.
R. Which Thou hast purchased of old.
V. Peace be within thy walls.
R. And prosperity within thy pallaces.
V. Let us pray for the Faithful departed.
R. O Lord, grant them eternal rest, and let the everlasting light shine upon them.
V. May they rest in peace.
R. Amen.
V. Let us pray for our absent brethren.
R. O Thou, my God, save Thy servants that trust in Thee.
V. Let us pray for the sorrowful and the captive.
R. Redeem them, O God of Israël, out of all their troubles.
V. O Lord, send them help from the sanctuary.
R. And strengthen them out of Zion.
V. Hear my prayer, O Lord.
R. And let my cry come unto Thee.
V. Turn us again, O Lord God of Hosts.
R. And cause Thy face to shine, and we shall be saved.
V. Arise, O Christ, and help us.
R. And deliver us for Thy Name's sake.

antiphona-i: Let us go * with gladness into the house of the Lord.
antiphona-ii: O Thou That dwellest * in the heavens, have mercy upon us.
antiphona-iii: Our help * is in the name of the Lord.
antiphona-iv: Do good, O Lord, * to the good, and to them that are upright in their hearts.
antiphona-v: We were like * them that come again from sickness.

datum: Let my spirit rejoice * in God my Saviour.

antiphona-i: He shall not be ashamed * when he speaketh with his enemies in the gate.
antiphona-ii: Blessed * is every one that feareth the Lord.
antiphona-iii: Many a time * have they afflicted me from my youth up.
antiphona-iv: Out of the depths * have I cried unto Thee, O Lord.
antiphona-v: Let Israël hope * in the Lord.

datum: The Lord hath regarded * my lowliness, and He That is mighty hath done in me great things.

antiphona-ii: Behold, * how good and how pleasant it is for brethren to dwell together in unity.
antiphona-iii: Whatsoever * the Lord pleased, that did He.
antiphona-iv: For his mercy * endureth for ever.
antiphona-v: Sing us one of the songs * of Zion.

datum: O God, * show strength with Thine arm: put down the mighty, and exalt them of low degree.

antiphona-i: Before the Angels * will I sing praise unto Thee, O my God.
antiphona-ii: O Lord, * Thou hast searched me and known me.
antiphona-iii: Preserve me, * O Lord, from the wicked man.
antiphona-iv: Lord, * I cry unto Thee, hear me.
antiphona-v: O Lord, let my portion * be in the land of the living.

datum: He hath put down * the mighty, that persecute His Saints: and hath exalted them of low degree, that confess His Christ.

antiphona-i: Blessed * be the Lord my God.
antiphona-ii: Every day * will I bless Thee, O Lord.
antiphona-iii: While I live * will I praise the Lord.
antiphona-iv: Let the praise of our God * be pleasant.

datum: O the depth of the riches and wisdom and knowledge of God: + how unsearchable are His judgments * and His ways past finding out!
V. Let the evening prayer ascend unto Thee, O Lord.
R. And let there descend upon us Thy mercy.
God hath holpen * His servant Israël: as He spake to Abraham and to his seed, to exalt them of low degree for ever and ever.
